properties.Script Body:
import groovy.json.*
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.OutputStreamCallback

def ff = session.get()
if (!ff) return

try {
    def json = new JsonSlurper().parse(session.read(ff))

    // Normally fetched from attributes / parameters
    def reportType = "TICKET_SUMMARY"
    def timeRange  = "LAST_24_HOURS"
    def startTime  = null
    def endTime    = null
    def locationId = null
    def department = null

    def out = [[
        report_type   : reportType,
        time_range    : timeRange,
        start_time    : startTime,
        end_time      : endTime,
        location_id   : locationId,
        department    : department,
        total_tickets : json.total,
        generated_at  : new Date().format("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX")
    ]]

    ff = session.write(ff, { os ->
        os.write(JsonOutput.toJson(out).getBytes("UTF-8"))
    } as OutputStreamCallback)

    session.transfer(ff, REL_SUCCESS)

} catch (Exception e) {
    def err = session.create(ff)
    def payload = [
        error_type: e.class.name,
        error_message: e.message,
        processor: "ticket_summary_report",
        timestamp: new Date().toString()
    ]
    err = session.write(err, { os ->
        os.write(JsonOutput.toJson(payload).getBytes("UTF-8"))
    } as OutputStreamCallback)
    session.transfer(err, REL_FAILURE)
    session.remove(ff)
}
